cases.sentence: В десятый день ___ народ вышел из Иордана и разбил лагерь в Гилгале на восточной стороне Иерихона.
cases.explain: «первого месяца» — the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: The people came up out of the Jordan on the tenth day of the first month, and encamped in Gilgal, on the east border of Jericho.

cases.translation: For Yahweh your God dried up the waters of the Jordan from before you until you had crossed over, as Yahweh your God did to the Red Sea, which he dried up from before us, until we had crossed over,
